name: Hollow Body Hold
description: The hollow body is the shape that transfers to handstands, levers, and planche. Master this first.

name: Plank
description: Forearm plank with intent. Squeeze everything—this is practice for maintaining tension under load.

name: L-Sit
description: A fundamental static hold that develops incredible core strength and hip flexor endurance.

name: Dragon Flag
description: Made famous by Bruce Lee. Keep the body as one unit—no bending at the hips.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
description: Hang from a bar, raise straight legs to horizontal or above. No swinging.

name: Bodyweight Squat
description: Full depth squat with control. Heels stay planted, chest stays tall.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
description: Rear foot elevated on a bench. Drop the back knee straight down.

name: Calf Raise
description: Single or double leg. Full range: heel below toes to max plantar flexion.

name: Nordic Curl
description: Kneel, anchor feet, lower your body forward under control. The negative is the exercise.

name: Pistol Squat
description: The ultimate single-leg strength exercise that builds leg power, balance, and mobility.

name: Shrimp Squat
description: Grab rear foot behind you and squat on one leg. Demands quad strength and balance.

name: Bridge Pose
description: Glute bridge to full bridge progression. Open the front body safely.

name: Cat-Cow Stretch
cues: Move one vertebra at a time
description: Flow between spinal flexion and extension. Breath-driven, slow.

name: Cobra Pose
description: Lie prone, press up through hands keeping hips grounded. Open the chest.

name: Deep Squat Hold
description: Sit in the bottom of a squat. Heels down, chest up. Breathe and explore the range.

name: Downward Dog
description: Inverted V shape. Push hips high, heels toward floor. Active shoulders.

name: Pigeon Pose
description: Front leg bent, back leg extended. Fold forward for intensity. Breathe into the hip.

name: Shoulder Dislocate
description: Wide grip on stick/towel, pass it over your head and behind your back. Gradual narrowing.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
description: Lunge, rotate, reach. Hits hips, T-spine, hamstrings, and groin in a single sequence.

name: Needle
description: An extreme flexibility skill showcasing total hamstring and hip mobility.

name: Australian Row
description: Inverted row under a low bar. Body stays straight. Pull chest to bar.

name: Chin-up
description: Underhand grip. Pull chin over bar. Full dead hang at bottom.

name: Pull-up
description: Overhand grip, dead hang to chin over bar. No kipping. Full ROM.

name: Archer Pull-up
description: Wide grip. Pull to one side while the other arm extends. Alternate sides.

name: Front Lever Raise
description: From dead hang, raise body to horizontal front lever position with straight arms.

name: Muscle-up
description: Explosive pull-up that transitions into a dip above the bar or rings.

name: Skin The Cat
description: A dynamic shoulder mobility exercise that builds the foundation for advanced ring work.

name: Pullover
description: A fundamental bar transition skill that combines pulling strength with hip flexibility.

name: Push-up
description: Hands shoulder-width, straight body, chest to floor and back up. Quality over quantity.

name: Diamond Push-up
description: Hands together forming a diamond. Emphasizes triceps and inner chest.

name: Archer Push-up
description: Wide hands. Lower to one side while other arm extends straight. Alternate.

name: Pike Push-up
description: Hips high in an inverted V. Press straight down and up. Builds HSPU strength.

name: Handstand Push-up
description: Wall-supported or freestanding. Head to floor and press back to full lockout.

name: Parallel Bar Dip
description: Dip between parallel bars or chairs. Shoulders below elbows at the bottom.

name: Tiger Bend Push Up
cues: Forearms to hands in one press
description: An advanced push-up variation that builds tricep strength for planche and handstand push-ups.

name: Planche Lean
description: Hands slightly behind shoulders. Lock elbows. Push floor away and lean forward while staying hollow.

name: Pseudo Planche Push-up
description: Hands slightly back. Lean forward before you descend. At the top: elbows lock + scap protraction + hollow stays tight.

name: Planche Plank
description: Elbows locked. Push floor away. Hollow body. Hold the line like you're freezing a screenshot.

name: Tuck Planche
description: From a strong lean: tuck knees tight to chest, shoulders forward, elbows locked, protract hard.

name: Advanced Tuck Planche
description: Tuck planche with hips raised higher and knees extending slightly. The bridge to straddle.

name: Straddle Planche
description: Legs spread wide, body horizontal, straight arms. The culmination of months of work.

name: Planche
description: Legs together, body perfectly horizontal, arms straight. Years of work distilled into one hold.

name: Chest-to-Wall Handstand
description: Face the wall, walk feet up. Chest close to wall. Build the vertical line and shoulder endurance.

name: Handstand Shrugs
description: In chest-to-wall HS, shrug up and depress down. Builds the active support.

name: Wall Pull-Aways
description: In chest-to-wall HS, gently pull feet off wall and balance for 2–5 seconds. Return to wall.

name: Freestanding Handstand
description: The king of bodyweight skills. A freestanding handstand demonstrates mastery of balance and body control.

name: Headstand
description: The gateway inversion that builds shoulder stability and body awareness for more advanced inversions.

name: Ring Support Hold
description: Hold yourself on top of rings with locked arms. Rings touching sides of body.

name: RTO Support Hold
description: Support hold with rings turned out 45–90°. Builds biceps tendon resilience.

name: Ring Dip
description: Full dip on rings. Deeper range than bars, higher instability demand.

name: Ring Row
description: Inverted row on rings. Body straight, pull rings to chest.

name: False Grip Hold
description: Hang from rings with wrists over the rings (false grip). Builds the grip for ring muscle-ups.

name: Tuck Sit
description: Lift off floor with tucked knees. Shoulders depressed, arms straight.

name: Seated Straddle Lift
description: Sit in a straddle, hands on floor between legs, lift feet off floor. Hold.

name: Frog Stand
description: The foundational balance skill that builds wrist strength and body awareness for advanced hand balancing.

name: Elbow Lever
description: A horizontal balance hold that creates the illusion of defying gravity.

name: Single Arm Elbow Lever
description: The ultimate elbow lever progression—balancing your entire body on one arm.

name: Back Lever
description: Hang face-down with body horizontal. Arms straight, full body tension.

name: Front Lever
description: Hang face-up with body horizontal. Straight arms, extreme lat and core demand.

name: Human Flag
description: An impressive display of lateral core strength and shoulder stability.

name: Clutch Flag
description: A horizontal flag variation performed on a vertical bar with a unique grip.

name: Bent Arm Handstand
description: A crocodile-style handstand that requires tremendous tricep and shoulder strength.

name: Straddle Handstand Kick-Ups
description: A straddle-leg kick-up for controlled handstand entry. Develops coordination and reduces fear of inversion.

name: Handstand Exits / Bail-Outs
cues: Turn hand, step down to side
description: Learn to safely exit a handstand via cartwheel turn-out or pirouette bail. Eliminates fear of falling and enables confident freestanding practice.

name: Dolphin Pose
description: Forearm down-dog position. Builds the shoulder opening and scapular strength needed for forearm stand.

name: Forearm Stand Toe Pulls
description: In a wall-supported forearm stand, gently pull toes off the wall to train balance. Develops the shoulder and core control for freestanding Pincha.

name: Forearm Stand Line Holds
cues: Squeeze glutes to close the line
description: A straight-line forearm stand held away from the wall. The culmination of Pincha training—demands shoulder stability and refined balance.

name: Elbow Stand Wall Holds
description: Practice an elbow stand against a wall to build the tricep strength and balance awareness needed for freestanding elbow stands.

name: Elbow Stand Straddle Entry
description: A straddle-leg entry into elbow stand that develops control and reduces the momentum needed compared to a straight-leg kick.

name: Elbow Stand Exits
description: Learn to safely exit an elbow stand by rolling out or stepping down. Protects the face and neck and builds confidence for longer holds.

name: Dead Hang
description: Hang from a bar with relaxed shoulders (passive) or depressed shoulders (active). Builds grip endurance and decompresses the spine.

name: Towel Hang
description: Hang from a towel draped over a pull-up bar. The thick, pliable surface forces forearms to work significantly harder than a standard bar hang.

name: Extensor Band Exercises
description: Use finger extensor bands to strengthen the often-neglected forearm extensors. Prevents imbalances from heavy grip work and reduces elbow injury risk.

name: Seated Pike Compression Lifts
description: Seated with legs together and straight, lift both feet off the floor using hip flexors. Builds the active compression needed for L-sit and press handstand.

name: Lunges
cues: Step length allows 90° at both knees
description: Forward or reverse lunge with control. Develops single-leg strength, balance, and hip stability as a foundation for pistol and shrimp squat progressions.

name: Cossack Squat
description: A deep side-to-side squat that develops hip mobility, adductor flexibility, and single-leg strength. Essential for well-rounded lower body development.

name: Wall Compression Stretch
description: Face a wall, place feet up the wall and actively compress chest to thighs. Builds the deep pike compression needed for press to handstand.

name: Elevated Chair Compression Drill
description: Hands on a chair/blocks, actively compress and lift legs in pike or straddle. The elevated surface allows deeper compression range.

name: Crocodile Pose (One-Arm Balance)
cues: Extend legs back and to side
description: A one-arm balance where the body extends laterally like a crocodile. Demands wrist strength, oblique engagement, and fearless lean.

name: HSPU Capacity Builder
description: Wall-supported partial-range handstand push-up drills focusing on building pressing capacity. Eccentric-focused negatives and pause reps.

name: Band-Assisted Progressions
description: Resistance band assistance for planche leans, front lever attempts, and other advanced holds. Allows proper form practice before full bodyweight.

name: Straddle Press to Handstand
cues: Straddle legs until vertical then close
description: From standing straddle, fold forward, place hands, and press up through a straddle to handstand with straight arms. The ultimate compression strength demonstration.

name: Stalder Press to Handstand
description: From a seated straddle on the floor, press to handstand without jumping. Requires extreme compression strength and shoulder leverage. The pinnacle of press handstand mastery.

name: Child's Pose
description: Kneel, sit back on heels, fold forward with arms extended. The universal rest and reset position.

name: Warrior I (Virabhadrasana I)
description: Deep lunge with back foot angled, arms reaching overhead. Builds leg strength and hip flexibility.

name: Warrior II (Virabhadrasana II)
description: Wide stance, front knee bent, arms extended parallel to floor. Gaze over front fingers.

name: Warrior III (Virabhadrasana III)
description: Standing on one leg, torso and back leg form a T-shape. Arms extend forward or alongside body.

name: Tree Pose (Vrksasana)
cues: Foot presses into thigh, thigh presses back
description: Stand on one leg, place other foot on inner thigh or calf (never the knee). Hands at heart or overhead.

name: Chair Pose (Utkatasana)
description: Sit back as if into a chair, arms reaching overhead. Builds leg endurance and core stability.

name: Triangle Pose (Trikonasana)
description: Wide stance, hinge at hip to reach one hand toward foot while other arm reaches skyward. Opens the entire side body.

name: Crow Pose (Bakasana)
description: Squat, place hands on floor, lean forward and lift feet. The gateway arm balance that connects yoga to planche progression.

name: Half Moon Pose (Ardha Chandrasana)
description: Balance on one leg with torso and lifted leg parallel to floor, top arm reaching skyward. Demands balance, hip opening, and core stability.

name: Wheel Pose (Urdhva Dhanurasana)
description: Full back bridge pushing up from floor. Demands shoulder mobility, spinal extension, and hip flexor openness. The advanced expression of bridge pose.

name: Camel Pose (Ustrasana)
description: Kneel, place hands on heels, and push hips forward while arching back. Opens the entire front body.

name: Press Handstand Journey Drills
description: A collection of drills combining pike compression, straddle lifts, and wall walks to build the specific strength for press to handstand.

name: Pancake Stretch
description: Sit in a wide straddle, fold chest to floor. The essential flexibility drill for straddle press, middle splits, and deep compression work.

name: Middle Split Hold
description: Isometric hold in the full middle split position. Made iconic by Jean-Claude Van Damme. The pinnacle of hip adductor flexibility.

name: Relevé
description: Stand tall, rise onto the balls of your feet with control, hold, and lower. Foundation for all ballet balance.

name: First Position Plié
description: Heels together, toes turned out. Bend knees over toes and rise with control. The most fundamental ballet movement.

name: Tendu
description: Slide foot along the floor extending to a fully pointed position and return. Builds foot articulation and turnout control.

name: Grand Plié
description: Full depth plié where heels may rise in first position. Develops deep hip mobility and leg endurance.

name: Port de Bras
description: Flowing arm movements through ballet positions. Develops shoulder mobility, upper body coordination, and expressive movement quality.

name: Passé Balance
description: Stand on one leg while the other foot draws up to the knee in turnout. Core balance and hip stability in action.

name: Arabesque Hold
cues: Lift from the glute not the back
description: Stand on one leg with the other extended behind, torso upright. Develops posterior chain strength, balance, and body line awareness.

name: Développé
description: Draw foot up the standing leg to passé then unfold to full extension. Tests hip flexor strength and hamstring flexibility simultaneously.

name: Rond de Jambe
description: Trace a semi-circle on the floor with the working leg. Develops hip joint range of motion and standing leg stability.

name: Grand Battement
cues: Kick from the hip not the knee
description: Powerful controlled kick to maximum height while maintaining posture. Builds dynamic flexibility and hip power.

name: Attitude Hold
description: Stand on one leg with the other lifted behind, knee bent at 90°. A sculptural position that demands balance and posterior chain engagement.

name: Penché
cues: Back leg drives up as torso lowers
description: Tilt forward from arabesque until the back leg reaches vertical. The pinnacle of ballet balance and hamstring flexibility combined.
